# Olympics.com
> The official digital home of the Olympic Movement, covering Olympic Games, athletes, sports, results, news, and IOC initiatives.

Olympics.com brings together live and historical coverage of the Olympic Games with athlete profiles, sport explainers, schedules, results, original video, and information about the International Olympic Committee and Olympic values.

## Olympic Games
- [Olympic Games](https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games): Hub for past, present, and upcoming Summer and Winter Olympic Games.
- [Paris 2024](https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024): Official coverage, results, highlights, and stories from the Paris 2024 Olympic Games.
- [Milano Cortina 2026](https://olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026): Official information and updates for the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics.
- [LA 2028](https://olympics.com/en/los-angeles-2028): Overview and latest news for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games.
- [Brisbane 2032](https://olympics.com/en/brisbane-2032): Host city information and planning updates for the Brisbane 2032 Olympic Games.
- [Youth Olympic Games](https://olympics.com/en/youth-olympic-games): Information about the Youth Olympic Games and participating young athletes.

## Results, Schedule, and Medal Tables
- [Olympic Results](https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/results): Official Olympic results across editions, sports, and events.
- [Olympic Medal Table](https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/medal-table): Medal standings by Games, nation, and overall Olympic history.
- [Paris 2024 Results](https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/results): Event-by-event results and medal outcomes from Paris 2024.
- [Paris 2024 Schedule](https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/schedule): Competition schedule and session listings for Paris 2024 events.
- [Milano Cortina 2026 Schedule](https://olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/schedule): Upcoming competition schedule and key dates for Milano Cortina 2026.
- [Olympic Records](https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/olympic-results): Historical Olympic performance data, records, and results archives.

## Athletes
- [Athletes](https://olympics.com/en/athletes): Directory of Olympic athletes with biographies, results, and related content.
- [Olympians](https://olympics.com/en/athletes): Search and browse athlete profiles across sports and Olympic editions.
- [Team USA Athletes](https://olympics.com/en/athletes?country=united-states): Athlete listings filtered by country for national team exploration.
- [Featured Athlete Stories](https://olympics.com/en/news/tags/athletes): News and feature stories focused on Olympic athletes.
- [Olympic Refuge Foundation](https://olympics.com/en/olympic-refuge-foundation): Information on support programs for displaced young people through sport.

## Sports
- [Olympic Sports](https://olympics.com/en/sports): Overview of Summer and Winter Olympic sports and disciplines.
- [Athletics](https://olympics.com/en/sports/athletics): Rules, events, history, and Olympic coverage for athletics.
- [Swimming](https://olympics.com/en/sports/swimming): Event information, athlete stories, and results for Olympic swimming.
- [Gymnastics Artistic](https://olympics.com/en/sports/artistic-gymnastics): Guide to artistic gymnastics events, format, and Olympic highlights.
- [Football](https://olympics.com/en/sports/football): Olympic football competition information, news, and results.
- [Alpine Skiing](https://olympics.com/en/sports/alpine-skiing): Winter Olympic alpine skiing overview, events, and athlete coverage.
- [Breaking](https://olympics.com/en/sports/breaking): Olympic breaking format, athlete profiles, and competition background.

## News and Features
- [Olympics News](https://olympics.com/en/news): Latest Olympic news, features, interviews, and explainers.
- [Olympic Channel](https://olympics.com/en/original-series): Original series and editorial video from Olympics.com.
- [Features](https://olympics.com/en/news/features): In-depth stories and long-form coverage from across the Olympic Movement.
- [Explainers](https://olympics.com/en/news/explainers): Background articles explaining sports, qualification, and Olympic topics.
- [Athlete365 News](https://olympics.com/athlete365/news): News and resources tailored for Olympic and elite athletes.

## Video and Streaming
- [Watch Video](https://olympics.com/en/video): Video hub for highlights, replays, interviews, and original content.
- [Replays](https://olympics.com/en/video/replays): Full-event replays and archived Olympic competition footage.
- [Highlights](https://olympics.com/en/video/highlights): Short-form highlight clips from Olympic sports and Games moments.
- [Original Series](https://olympics.com/en/original-series): Documentary and magazine-style series produced by Olympics.com.
- [Live Events](https://olympics.com/en/live): Live streams and current event coverage where available.

## IOC and the Olympic Movement
- [International Olympic Committee](https://olympics.com/ioc): Overview of the IOC, its role, leadership, and activities.
- [Olympic Movement](https://olympics.com/ioc/olympic-movement): Structure and participants of the global Olympic Movement.
- [Olympic Agenda](https://olympics.com/ioc/olympic-agenda): Strategic reforms and policy priorities of the IOC.
- [Olympic Solidarity](https://olympics.com/ioc/olympic-solidarity): Funding and development programs supporting athletes and NOCs worldwide.
- [Olympism 365](https://olympics.com/ioc/olympism365): IOC initiatives using sport to advance social development goals.
- [Safe Sport](https://olympics.com/ioc/safe-sport): Policies and resources promoting athlete safeguarding in sport.

## Values, Education, and Legacy
- [Olympic Values](https://olympics.com/ioc/olympic-values): Core principles of excellence, friendship, and respect in Olympism.
- [Olympic Museum](https://olympics.com/museum): Digital access to Olympic heritage, collections, and exhibitions.
- [Olympic Studies Centre](https://olympics.com/ioc/olympic-studies-centre): Research resources and archives on Olympic history and the Movement.
- [Sustainability](https://olympics.com/ioc/sustainability): IOC sustainability strategy, reporting, and environmental initiatives.
- [Gender Equality and Inclusion](https://olympics.com/ioc/gender-equality): IOC work on inclusion, representation, and equal opportunity in sport.
- [Legacy](https://olympics.com/ioc/legacy): Long-term impact of the Olympic Games on host cities and communities.

## Athletes and Stakeholders
- [Athlete365](https://olympics.com/athlete365): Career, wellbeing, education, and competition resources for athletes.
- [Athlete365 Career+](https://olympics.com/athlete365/career): Career development support for athletes during and after sport.
- [Athlete365 Learning](https://olympics.com/athlete365/learning): Educational courses and learning resources for elite athletes.
- [Athlete365 Mental Health](https://olympics.com/athlete365/well-being): Wellbeing guidance and mental health support resources.
- [NOCs](https://olympics.com/ioc/national-olympic-committees): Information about National Olympic Committees around the world.
- [IFs](https://olympics.com/ioc/international-federations): Directory and role of International Federations within the Olympic Movement.

## Tickets, Hospitality, and Shop
- [Tickets](https://olympics.com/en/tickets): Official ticketing information and links for Olympic Games events.
- [Hospitality](https://olympics.com/en/hospitality): Official hospitality information for upcoming Olympic Games.
- [Olympic Shop](https://shop.olympics.com/): Official store for Olympic apparel, collectibles, and merchandise.
- [Paris 2024 Shop](https://shop.olympics.com/en/paris-2024/o-1276+t-3497550868+z-9-1799366016): Official Paris 2024 merchandise and fanwear.
- [Milano Cortina 2026 Shop](https://shop.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/o-3478+t-35589049+z-95040-1238555770): Official Milano Cortina 2026 merchandise and branded products.
